def transform(grid):
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    width = len(grid[0])
    shifted = [row[:width] + [bg] * max(0, width - len(row)) for row in grid[:-1]]
    return [[bg] * width] + shifted
'''
